event_identity: event_id equals session_id + : + decimal event_seq; seq starts at 1, contiguous; exact retained duplicates idempotent, expired sequences rejected; conflicting reuse rejected
ordering: receipt sequence authoritative, timestamps finite nondecreasing; out of order rejected atomically, never queued or silently reordered
ownership: single process; RLock guards transitions; predictor call outside lock; one active or pending turn; shared model serialized by caller; no custom async framework
context: last 3 successfully perceived finalized human turns across participants, exact original speaker keys and text; no robot/partial/cancelled/failed turn or inferred-state input
audio: mono floating point 16kHz PCM copied to float32 as existing Session; unchanged concatenation and final preprocessing; over 60s discards retained PCM and uses explicit duration-limit execution sentinel; missing/corrupt/silence preserved; no per-chunk normalization/resampling
failure: observed ended turn remains observed, execution failed, no final snapshot and no T1 context append; release PCM and allow fresh turn; no retry of same end event; new turn required
snapshots: frozen canonical JSON strings, defensive parsed copies; partial input checkpoint has no model estimate; final B and D2 separate; IDs hash session/turn/event/input/model semantic content; deterministic created_at from event timestamp; measured timing excluded from canonical payload
